nodes.norm_label: global claude code instructions (lsp-first navigation, playwright-cli)
nodes.rationale: Prefer LSP (goToDefinition, findReferences, hover) over Grep/Glob/Read so navigation is semantic; findReferences before renames; check diagnostics after edits.

nodes.label: Hermes daily update timer/service (hermes-update.timer)
nodes.rationale: Runs in a separate systemd unit outside the gateway cgroup so hermes update can drain and restart the gateway without killing its own process.

nodes.label: AdeoTEK Bash scripting conventions
nodes.rationale: Enforced because the dotfiles scripts run destructive system installs; strict conditionals, no set -e, explicit return-code checks, dry-run guards and shellcheck reduce risk of partial installs and broken hosts.

nodes.label: Zed ACP agent integration (OpenCode / Claude in Agent Panel)
nodes.norm_label: zed acp agent integration (opencode / claude in agent panel)
nodes.rationale: Agents keep their own auth (~/.opencode, ~/.claude); keys never live in the public dotfiles repo, so only registration pointers are stowed.

nodes.label: VSCode base keymap choice in Zed
nodes.norm_label: vscode base keymap choice in zed
nodes.rationale: base_keymap VSCode keeps muscle memory from VS Code; machine-specific keybindings are kept out of the stowed file to avoid stow clashes.

nodes.label: Foca - senior software engineer & architect persona
nodes.norm_label: foca - senior software engineer & architect persona
nodes.rationale: Narrowed scope (software dev only) so answers stay concise and requirements are clarified before solutions are proposed.

nodes.label: Mo - peer-level assistant & Hermes maintainer persona
nodes.norm_label: mo - peer-level assistant & hermes maintainer persona
nodes.rationale: Persona is scoped to all-round assistance plus owning the Hermes setup's stability, so the agent flags risks and refuses unapproved breaking changes.

nodes.label: lazy.nvim restructured Kickstart layout
nodes.rationale: One spec file per plugin under lua/plugins/ auto-imported, so adding a plugin or LSP server needs no central registration except the servers/tools tables.

nodes.label: GNU Stow symlink-based config management
nodes.rationale: Stow was chosen so editing a repo file immediately changes the live system; no copying, easy per-package enable/disable, automatic .bak backups.

nodes.label: Package tier hierarchy (Minimal/Console/Desktop)
nodes.rationale: Tiers exist so users can install a small essential set or grow to full dev/desktop setups without editing package lists.
